activity.role: Scholar and creator of the Armenian alphabet
activity.notes: Mesrop Mashtots is represented at the securely attested 405 CE creation of the Armenian alphabet. This is a person-specific historical milestone and not a fabricated lifetime or career interval. The existing Kingdom of Armenia identity is reused for the early-fifth-century Armenian royal context.

sources.title: Armenian letter art and its cultural expressions — UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage
sources.citation_text: UNESCO states that Armenian letter art is based on the Armenian alphabet created in 405 AD by Mesrop Mashtots.

sources.title: Մեսրոպ Մաշտոց, 362-440 — National Library of Armenia authority record
sources.citation_text: The National Library of Armenia authority record identifies Mesrop Mashtots as the creator of Armenian writing and a founder of Armenian literary and school traditions.
